title: Synra schema index
description: The shape of /schema/index.json. That file is data, not a schema: it lists every JSON Schema Synra publishes so tooling can discover the current version instead of hard-coding a URL.

generatedNote.description: A note for anyone who opens the data file directly.

name.description: Short name of the schema, used as the directory in its URL.

version.description: Version number as it appears in the path, for example `1` for `v1.json`.

url.description: Absolute URL of the schema. This URL is immutable.

current.description: True for the version a new plugin should use. Exactly one version should carry it.
